summary: candidate O on Cu(111) (metal surface adsorbate, trust tier)

O on Cu(111) adsorption_energy = -4.84 eV via ASE 3.29 + mace-torch 0.3.15 (MACECalculator, float64, CUDA)/MACE-MPA-0 medium (universal MLIP trained on PBE/PBE+U MPtrj+sAlex) Static 0 K relaxation (BFGS, fmax 0.01 eV/A). E_ads = E(O/slab) - E(slab) - E(O atom). Cu lattice constant relaxed first (a0 = 3.640 A). Cu(111) slab 3x3x4 with 8 A vacuum each side, bottom 2 layers fixed, coverage 1/9 ML. Sites tried: fcc, hcp, top, bridge (bridge relaxed into fcc). Isolated O atom = single O in a 20 A box, i.e. the model's per-element reference energy E0 (no spin state). Checked convergence with 2x2x4, 4x4x5 (10 A vacuum) and 3x3x6 slabs.
